source: Owner direct chat after the proposed combat and opening episode progression
owner_message_original: Давай подготовим задачи для всего этого, будем действовать последовательно
owner_message_english_translation: Let's prepare tasks for all of this; we will proceed sequentially.
decision: Prepare a sequential Multica task family covering meaningful rifle hits and ammunition, enemies and player survival, a short lobby encounter, body and environment damage, time slowdown, force push, telekinesis, and a bounded opening episode.
planning_detail: The 14-stage breakdown, prototype counts and configurable tuning are controller planning choices, not separately quoted owner requirements or final balance decisions.

owner_scope.sequence: Proceed one bounded task at a time, with verification and corrections before advancing.
owner_scope.baseline: Build on the purchased first-person arms/rifle and existing movement in the retained lobby.
owner_scope.combat: Real hits, damage and ammunition; a functioning enemy; player health and restart; a short encounter using cover.
owner_scope.damage_and_abilities: Representative enemy body damage and environmental destruction, followed by time slowdown, force push and telekinesis as separate tasks.
owner_scope.episode: Plan and then implement the opening exploration, surveillance information and progression using fixed StoryCanon facts, with unresolved staging kept as proposals.

preservation: Original protagonist modeling and deferred lobby architecture remain paused. Preparing gameplay tasks does not approve new art, structural changes, purchases or unresolved story staging.
dependency_representation: Native parent/stage plus existing metadata.depends_on convention. No automatic dependency enforcement or successor dispatch.
